liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Tennessee Jed** (1 review): Played at an up-tempo pace with an abundance of twang factor [10]
- **Greatest Story Ever Told** (1 review): One of the most blistering versions, though DJG's performance is criticized [17]
- **Here Comes Sunshine** (1 review): Listener highlights this track, along with Playin' In The Band, as a standout [9]
- **Truckin'** (1 review): Truckin' to Other One to Eyes to Stella Blue to Sugar Magnolia is spectacular [19]
- **The Other One** (1 review): Jam is described as really solid despite Jerry's wobbly vocal delivery [9]

## The recordings

- **gd73-05-20.sbd-patched.schlissel.24495.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 33 songs; 219 min; rated 4.74/5 by 19 [1]. Said about its sound: Show is very long and excruciatingly well patched, particularly Here Comes Sunshine [17]
- **gd73-05-20.sbd.weiner-warner.19564.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 33 songs; 219 min; rated 4.31/5 by 16 [3]. Said about its sound: Recording is slightly low on bass, but Billy's performance is exceptionally strong; Overall effect is dazzling, though the recording contains some annoying audio patches [8][10]
- **gd1973-05-20.sbd.miller.86905.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 32 songs; 218 min; rated 4.69/5 by 13 [5]. Said about its sound: Uploader cleaned flaws, fixed levels, and noted seamless disc changes [5]
- **gd73-05-20.set3-sbd.cribbs.16531.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 8 songs; 67 min; rated 1.5/5 by 2 [6]. Said about its sound: Audio is slightly low with some hiss, but the playing is absolutely off the chain [12]
- **gd1973-05-20.sbd-set3.wow.16158.shnf**: soundboard; 8 songs; 67 min [7]. Said about its sound: Digital hiccup occurs at the beginning, and levels drop at 3:50 in Stella Blue [7]

## Around the show

- Over 20,000 fans attended the sunny, breezy day at the former football stadium [15]
- Jerry sang with a bad cold, compensating with crisp, tight guitar leads [16]
- Reviewer calls this one of the most energized performances from 1973 [8]
- Truckin' to Other One to Eyes sequence is similar to May 13 and 26 [14]
- Reviewer suggests getting the soundboard version, as Kezar on the 26th might be better [14]
- Cited as the best pre-November version, though March 24 reaches higher heights [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd73-05-20.sbd-patched.schlissel.24495.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]
- **gd73-05-20.sbd.weiner-warner.19564.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [3]
- **gd1973-05-20.sbd.miller.86905.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel (7 inch reels @ 7.5ips 1/2trk) -> Dat -> CD D [5]. Also: Signal path includes Sony mic, master cassette, reel, cassette, DAT, and CD [5]
- **gd73-05-20.set3-sbd.cribbs.16531.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [6]
- **gd1973-05-20.sbd-set3.wow.16158.shnf**: transferred by Sly Wow; source: SBD>MR>C>DAT>CDR [7]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Bob Marks Grateful Dead: [1973-05-20 Stadium, UC Santa Barbara, Santa Barbara, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1973-05-20-stadium-uc-santa-barbara-santa-barbara-ca-usa/) [21]
- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1973-05-20 Ticket - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1973-05-20-ticket/) [22]
